newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka stocks close flat, buyers on sidelines.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka stocks close flat, buyers on sidelines.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks closed flat on Tuesday as profit-taking drove buyers to the sidelines, brokers said.
The all share index closed 0.89 points higher at 628.94, on turnover of 19 million rupees. Ceylon Brewery rose one rupee to 40 and Lanka Orix Leasing two to 152.

"While waiting on the sidelines to see how far down profit-taking will push the index, buyers are also picking stocks at current levels," said Ajit Dias Wanigasekera, a broker at Commercial Stock Brokers.
Profit-taking has set in since the all share has gained four percent so far this year, brokers said.
Foreign buying was worth 3.7 million rupees, and selling was 494,303.
Lion Brewery, which issued 12.5 million shares at 20 rupees a 10-rupee share in November 1996, begins trading on Wednesday.
Brokers say the share should open at a premium to its issue price, since the public offer was heavily oversubscribed within two days.
